items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Even though I'm married, it'll be 39 years this August 19, to the same woman. But who needs it? I don't need it. I don't need no woman. But my own Aline Eileen Crawford.

ctx.x: Yeah. They'd make it hard on you,

if they see you try to make a white woman. Not biting my tongue, they can't touch me now. I do what I want to do, I'm just that belligerent. Even though I'm married, it'll be 39 years this August 19, to the same woman. But who needs it? I don't need it. I don't need no woman. But my own Aline Eileen Crawford. That's the only thing I need, the only woman. The rest, I'm a good, jovial greeter.
